purpose: Paired observations on identical bounded public evidence, preserving headings, conditions and missing evidence; no accuracy ranking or specialist acceptance.
selection_reason: Revisit the omitted no-partner heading; inspect general Pension Credit and additional-benefit paths; retain the DLA/PIP cohort challenge; test ambiguous SDA alternatives and an unknown-term abstention control. Selection precedes model outputs.
freeze_policy: Explicit immutable DWP and Explorer commits are required. Verify inputs and engine bytes against their committed blobs, retain snapshots and exact contexts, and refuse to overwrite an existing frozen directory. No model calls before the root task confirms the candidate.
tool_policy: Request external evidence tools, shell, web, MCP and memory disabled through established process-local controls. Claude safe mode suppresses project customisations; Codex disables discovered user skill paths and uses an empty temporary directory. Host/system additions may still differ, so identical whole provider system context is not established. Reject unknown event/content categories, incomplete streams and observed tool events except Claude StructuredOutput, a schema-only formatter; retain its name and argument digest. Source instructions are inert.
model_policy: Use existing subscription CLI defaults with no model override, fallback override, paid API or persistent configuration change. Record observed response and accounting model identities separately; unknown is valid, and more than one identity is not a controlled single-model trial.
retry_policy: One explicit case/provider per --run, using an unused attempt-NN directory. Preserve every failure, timeout and retry. No automatic retries or repaired answers.
retention_policy: Retain only public context, authored prompts, schema, structured final answers, sanitised model identities, tool-event categories/digests, numerical usage and timings. Do not publish raw CLI logs, reasoning, account/session identifiers, credentials, local skill paths or stderr.
review_policy: Mechanical schema, exact-quotation, source-locator and boundary checks are followed by claim-level model review and pending independent specialist review. A fragment can match literally yet omit a controlling heading or condition. No model answer is gold.
historical_comparison: Both the context and the authored prompt differ from staff-2026-09-20. Before/after differences cannot be attributed solely to the evidence, prompt, engine or model. Preserve original trials unchanged; no causal improvement or accuracy-ranking claim.
cost_policy: Numerical provider accounting is not verified subscription charges, future affordability or human review cost.
